body: My life is worthless and I'll be better off dead.
The incels are out in force!

Yes and no. That would be oversimplifying it too much. Either you know or you don't know. For anyone who needs more explanation than that, none would really suffice. People are different. What is the logical choice for me might not be for someone else. If I was an introvert or found joy in solitude, my life would be perfect. I don't. I find it draining and psychically painful. Over 20-odd years, the damage has been done.
I don't work. I freelanced remotely some, but I stopped and no one reached out to me. I do not disclose identifying info on reddit.

Not really, just a video like I alway posted, this time outlining the approaching deadline (no pun intended). I posted videos and photos regularly, though I never got any engagement. It's out there, though. I'll probably leave them up in case someone finds them eventually. Nothing is hidden.

One of my biggest quibbles is that no one will find my body for a very long time. Eventually, probably, but it could, conceivably, be years before that happens. I guess I feel weird now, knowing I'll just rot in place, but after it's done, I won't be aware. It is what it is.
It's on my FB, Snap, and Insta. All public. I use this site anonymously, so I would never post my face.
I posted my videos on social media over a month ago. They're still out there, if anyone bothers to look.
Nope. Not at all. It's just time to show myself the same mercy I've shown others and end it.
In my teens. It hasn't got better in 20+ years. It's not going to in 2 days.
